findings: CAG-001 CRITICAL PACKAGE_INTEGRITY — docs/architecture/solution-architecture.md:3-18 identifies PRS-ARCH-001 version 0.4 and its author but provides no architecture-package digest, bound repository revision, immutable source manifest, or aggregate identity for the overview, LikeC4 source, and ADR set. The independence actors are identifiable, but package integrity cannot be established; disposition: BLOCKED.

CAG-002 HIGH NOT_RUN — architecture/model.c4:1-164 contains four required views, but docs/architecture/solution-architecture.md:421,450 requires `likec4 validate`, and section 21 records syntax compatibility only as DA-001. No repository LikeC4 package, configuration, executable, or validation result exists. Parsing and rendering therefore remain unverified; disposition: prevents PASS.

CAG-003 HIGH TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION — docs/architecture/solution-architecture.md:261 and ADR-002:24-26 state that the publisher claims DBML rows, publishes, and then records the outcome, while DBML:401-403 prescribes `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`. The package says publication is outside the business transaction but does not explicitly require the claim transaction to commit before RabbitMQ I/O. It therefore leaves open a broker call while a database transaction or lock is held; disposition: requires architecture correction.

CAG-004 HIGH ADR_INCOMPLETE — ADR-001 through ADR-005 are material Proposed decisions but omit mandatory Owner, Date or decision version, and Supersession relationship fields. ADR-001 through ADR-004 label decisions as TO-BE while ADR-005 uses different decision-status wording. Their exact approval and supersession lifecycle is not auditable; disposition: prevents PASS after package identity is restored.

CAG-005 HIGH QUARKUS_PROFILE_VIOLATION — docs/architecture/solution-architecture.md identifies Java 25, Quarkus, reactive execution, PostgreSQL, OpenAPI, OCI promotion, and architecture tests, but it does not bind the architecture technology profile to pinned Quarkus 3.33.3 or explicitly account for required Flyway, JUnit, Testcontainers, JaCoCo, and ArchUnit boundaries/evidence. Repository pinning in gradle.properties does not substitute for an architecture-package decision; disposition: requires architecture completion.

CAG-006 MEDIUM ARCHITECTURE_TRACEABILITY_GAP — docs/architecture/solution-architecture.md:470-481 groups broad requirement ranges rather than tracing each critical requirement through a specific ADR, LikeC4 element or relation, component boundary, and validation method. Amendment-level ownership is visible, but critical transaction, trust, and sensitive-data flows lack complete row-level architecture traceability; disposition: requires bounded correction.
